question: Do more manager review hours on an engagement lower the chance that the client restates within two years?

decision_rule.metric: effect of one more manager review hour on the probability of a restatement within two years

column_notes.manager_review_hours: hours the engagement manager logged on review; blank when not logged
column_notes.client_complexity: 1-5 risk and complexity rating set at acceptance, before any review hours
column_notes.restatement_within_2y: 1 = the client restated the audited financials within two years
